_comment: Hand-kept DeFiLlama pool UUID → on-chain deposit/receipt contract, for venues no API resolves (lib/carryScan/verify.ts resolveAddress).
NEVER GUESS AN ADDRESS: an entry is added only after the contract was read back on-chain (code, asset(), totalAssets within ±15% of DeFiLlama TVL),
and the scan re-checks all three at every run, so a wrong entry fails closed into the Unverified list. Addresses lowercase.
Sources for candidate addresses: the net-APY registry, KNOWN_VENUES, tools/venue-recorder.config.json, and the route-cohort seed (onAppAliases.json).
